sect2.title: Texto ao longo de vetor
sect2.para: This command creates a path from the outline of each selected text layer. Each path can be managed through the Paths Dialog. For more information see also Text to Path in Text Management.

note.para: This command only appears in the Layer menu if at least one text layer is selected.

listitem.para:
You can access this command from the main menu through
Layer Text to Path .
From the Layers Dialog, you can access it through the Text to Path command of its context menu.
